name: waypoint-ui
description: Waypoint's client half (waypoint.js): wp-* attributes for partial navigation, named handlers and automatic CSRF headers. Built into ../src/Waypoint/UI/waypoint.js and shipped with the PHP package.

scripts.check:bundle: tsc --noEmit && esbuild src/index.ts --bundle --minify --outfile=dist/check.js --target=es2019 --log-level=warning && (cmp -s dist/check.js ../src/Waypoint/UI/waypoint.js && echo 'waypoint.js is up to date' || (echo 'src/Waypoint/UI/waypoint.js is out of date -- run: composer build:ui' >&2; exit 1))
